title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode13 Whose Side Are You On?

meta.Episode: Episode13 — Whose Side Are You On?

rows.Line: One week later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I haven't seen Saki around in a while.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wonder if something happened. Could she have had a relapse?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What's up, Honami?
What are you doing in front of my classroom?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I, um...wanted to ask you about Saki. I noticed she's been absent lately. Did she have to go back to the hospital?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, she just has a persistent cold. I went to her house to see her yesterday. Her fever's finally gone down.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, really? I'm glad it's nothing serious.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I saw Tsukasa, too, for the first time in ages.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He put on his own one-man musical to cheer Saki up and make her feel better.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... He never changes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
For a moment, you talked to me normally again.
That was nice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, listen...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho joined our band. She explained about why she'd been acting so cold and distant.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, really...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Are you sure you wouldn't like to join us too?
That you don't want to hang out with us again?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry. I'm one to talk...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wasn't there for you when you were going through a rough time, so I can't expect you to want to be friends with me now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't say that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You've done nothing wrong, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate A
rows.Line: Honami, mind if I rant a bit? This other girl from my club was sooo mean to me. Listen...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So that's what happened. Are you okay? Try to calm down.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate B
rows.Line: And like, how could she say that to my face? What did I do to deserve that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see... That's kind of sad to hear...

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate C
rows.Line: Honami, you got a moment? I need to talk to you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, sure. What do you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate C
rows.Line: I heard you were talking crap about me after class yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? I'd never...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Two girls from my school club were kicking up a fuss over what I said to them. You agreed with them, no?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate C
rows.Line: Whose side are you on?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I wasn't taking sides...

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate C
rows.Line:
I heard that you always tell people what they want to
hear. Some people-pleaser you are.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's not what I was...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's just that... It's hard to not have anyone to talk to
when you're hurt. I thought it would help them...

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate C
rows.Line: A friend to everybody is a friend to nobody.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate C
rows.Line:
You thought you could make everybody like you by nodding
and smiling at anything they say, huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it wasn't like that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you sure you're all right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you don't want to talk now, that's fine, but know that you can always count on me. That's what friends are for.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate B
rows.Line: I saw Honami chatting to some friend in the hallway. I swear she was complaining we're bullying her here.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate C
rows.Line: Pfft! I gave her a piece of my mind for being such a bootlicker and now she's acting all hurt.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate C
rows.Line: She just wants to play the victim. That friend of hers is just the same, taking her side without even bothering to find out what happened.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate A
rows.Line:
I see Honami talking to that girl all the time.
Her name's Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey, Honami! Want to walk home together?
There's a new bakery we could stop by on the way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please don't talk to me at school anymore.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Why don't you want to talk to me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I already made up with my classmates, so you don't have to worry about me. Okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, I don't get it... Wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I knew it.
I shouldn't have just left you like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You offered to help, and that counts. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But... I'm scared, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't want my classmates to whisper things behind my back, or laugh at me, or ignore me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It felt so awful, and I don't want to go through that ever again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't want them to call me a bootlicker, or a people-pleaser who's friends with everybody, and friends with nobody.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So... I decided to prove my loyalty to them by not having friends outside our class.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can't be serious!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What they said to you was just nasty! You're kind to everyone and there's nothing wrong with that. I know you, Honami, they don't!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Honami! The school store was almost sold out of buns, so I bought all they had left for us all to share!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line:
These custard buns are all the rage!
Huh? Honami, are you coming?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry, I've got to go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I...don't even know what friendship is anymore.
